name: West Side Soccer League
tagline: AYSO Region 473 — volunteer-run youth soccer on Manhattan's West Side
footerNote:
WSSL is a Region of the American Youth Soccer Organization (AYSO). AYSO is a tax-exempt organization under section 501(c)(3) of internal revenue code. Donations to WSSL are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by the law. If you would like to make a tax-deductible donation to WSSL to support our programs, fields and scholarship initiatives, visit our donations page. Our taxpayer identification number is 95-6205398.

Note the registration fees and other payments for players are NOT tax-deductible.
